messages:
zoe: Kicking off Acme marketplace onboarding thread. Need three things aligned: (1) AWS/GCP/Azure provisioning callbacks, (2) optional customer-managed KMS/CMEK guidance, (3) EU-only data residency for EU customers. Who can pick each?

harry: I can own AWS/GCP callback wiring. Ask: does Acme want JWT-signed callbacks or HMAC token? JWT preferred bc publishers can rotate keys. Will post sample schema.

ana: Product: Starter plan = instant trial (14d), Enterprise = manual license attach via partner webhook. UX requires telemetry consent immediately after provisioning. Also need copy for marketplace listing short + long description.

claire-legal: Telemetry must be explicit opt-in. For EU data residency, we need to state region-by-account and offer a contractual addendum for EU-only storage. Draft clause: "Customer accounts designated EU will store and process data within EU regions; logs required for compliance may be exported under customer request." Will attach draft.

harry: Sample JWT claims for callback (replace placeholders):
```
{
  "iss": "marketplace-publisher",
  "sub": "account-123",
  "plan": "starter",
  "redirect": "https://acme.app/onboard/callback",
  "iat": 1809991234,
  "exp": 1809991534,
  "nonce": "abc123"
}
```
Also recommend TLS mutual auth between Redwood and Acme endpoints for extra security.

zoe: For KMS: Acme wants optional BYOK. We'll document recommended KMS policy and a quick test mode where Redwood uses its managed key. Har ry, can you list required KMS permissions?

harry: For AWS KMS minimal actions: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*, kms:DescribeKey. For GCP CMEK: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key resource. We'll add sample IAM bindings to the ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket MKP-999 - "Acme marketplace webhooks + BYOK + EU residency" and assigned to @harry/@zoe/@ana/@claire-legal. https://boards.internal/issue/MKP-999

ana: Copy task: I'll draft short description (1-line) and detailed plan copy. Short line idea: "Redwood + Acme: scalable AI infra via marketplace." Will iterate.

claire-legal: One more: if reseller billing is used for Enterprise, we need reseller clause and evidence of partner agreement. Request Acme legal contact.

zoe: Next steps: harry post JWT + KMS snippets to MKP-999; ana draft marketplace copy + telemetry UX text; claire finalize EU addendum + reseller clause ask. Standup 10:30 PT tomorrow. Ping here with blockers. :white_check_mark:
